title: E-FRC-0169: light on the husk: the bulk U(1) leapfrog projected onto the cubic horosphere of the {3,4,3,4} cusp...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0169 in the gauge arena: light on the husk: the bulk U(1) leapfrog projected onto the cubic horosphere of the {3,4,3,4} cusp carries 2 massless polarizations with the longitudinal one pinned by Gauss's law, at the speed of the plaquette-renormalized coupling, isotropic where the plain cubic lattice is not, and a love and a fear whose projected flux relaxes to the husk's Coulomb field, falling as 1 / r where the bulk's falls faster.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
